scripts.start: cd expo && EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx expo start
scripts.start:metro: cd expo && EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx expo start --dev-client
scripts.prebuild:local: cd expo && EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx expo prebuild --clean
scripts.prebuild:staging: cd expo && APP_ENV=staging EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx dotenv -c staging -- expo prebuild --clean
scripts.prebuild:production: cd expo && APP_ENV=production EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx dotenv -c production -- expo prebuild --clean
scripts.build:android:staging: cd expo && APP_ENV=staging EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx dotenv -c staging -- ./scripts/eas-local-build.sh -p android --profile staging --no-wait
scripts.build:android:production: cd expo && APP_ENV=production EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx dotenv -c production -- ./scripts/eas-local-build.sh -p android --profile production --non-interactive --no-wait
scripts.build:android:production-apk: cd expo && APP_ENV=production EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx dotenv -c production -- ./scripts/eas-local-build.sh -p android --profile production-apk --non-interactive --no-wait
scripts.build:ios:staging: cd expo && APP_ENV=staging EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx dotenv -c staging -- ./scripts/eas-local-build.sh -p ios --profile production --no-wait --non-interactive
scripts.build:ios:production: cd expo && APP_ENV=production EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 npx dotenv -c production -- ./scripts/eas-local-build.sh -p ios --profile production --no-wait --non-interactive
scripts.android:no-bundler: cd expo && EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx expo run:android --no-bundler --device
scripts.android:auto: cd expo && adb forward tcp:5277 tcp:5277 && "$ANDROID_HOME/extras/google/auto/desktop-head-unit" -c ./config/android-auto-dhu.ini
scripts.android:auto:portrait: cd expo && adb forward tcp:5277 tcp:5277 && "$ANDROID_HOME/extras/google/auto/desktop-head-unit" -c ./config/android-auto-dhu-portrait.ini
scripts.ios:no-bundler: cd expo && EXPO_OFFLINE=${EXPO_OFFLINE:-1} npx expo run:ios --no-bundler --device
